title: SEC0: /tmp/kithd fallback is unsafe and ephemeral
description:
Config::from_env() at config.rs:18-19 falls back to /tmp/kithd when HOME is unset. This fallback is problematic:
- /tmp/ is world-writable; vulnerable to symlink/TOCTOU attacks
- /tmp is typically cleaned on reboot, losing all data
- Code prints warning but continues with unsafe path
- No validation that path exists or is writable until runtime

Legitimate case where HOME might be unset: systemd services without User= directive, some container runtimes, or CI/CD scripts.

Fix: Treat missing HOME as a fatal error. Output clear error message and exit(1) rather than silently using /tmp.
